title: Gateway Routing Configuration
description: The routing file maps public model names to backends with api_base pointing to host.docker.internal.

steps.description: File purpose: this is llmproxy/litellm_config.yaml, the gateway routing configuration.
Model mappings: llama3 and qwen2.5-3b each map to ollama backends via host.docker.internal.
Api_base: both models use http://host.docker.internal:11434 to reach host-resident Ollama.
